_source: Texas entries are grounded in real, named 2025-2026 developments cited in the project brief (SB6, the Aug 2026 grid-tied interconnection pause, Fort Worth/San Antonio application pauses, Hill County's moratorium, Hood County's two rejections). Entries for every other state are a generic placeholder — no state-specific regulatory dataset is modeled yet for them. See README for how to extend this per state.

TX.gridTiedPauseNote: Gov. Abbott's Aug 2026 order pauses new grid-tied interconnections pending audit — self-generated facilities are exempt.

Tarrant.reason: Fort Worth has paused new datacenter applications.

Hood.reason: Hood County rejected two prior siting attempts.

Hill.reason: Hill County passed a moratorium on new datacenter development.

Travis.reason: Residential buffer zone — too close to dense residential development.

Hays.reason: Edwards Aquifer recharge zone — protected from new impervious development.

Bexar.reason: San Antonio has paused new datacenter applications.
